record: Families dealt to the colonies: build step 2 of docs/COLONIES.md
verdictMeaning: On the colonies map a class's families are dealt one to Gonzales, one to Liberty and the rest by 1834 population; each has land a few miles from its settlement by a named watercourse and within 30 road miles of it; each trades at a store in its own town; each arrives near its own settlement. The invented Gonzales map, still the default, is unchanged.
ownerDecisions: 2026-09-14: new classes keep the Gonzales map by default until step 5.

measured.worlds: 60 of 60 built (5, 10, 15, 20, 30 families x 12 seeds), slowest 241 ms

foundWhileBuilding: A Liberty family was given land across the Trinity: its nearest reachable road took it 228 miles to Liberty. Land now needs a way to its own town within 30 road miles.
The first timber stands for Mina and Liberty went on Gills Branch and Big Bayou, nearer than the Colorado and the Trinity; the settlement's own river within three miles is preferred.
A track to Liberty's lower timber waded the Trinity: the stand sat across a meander. Stands now move to where their route ends, and a routed road is never simplified across a river.
A first map kept every creek and its timber round each settlement: 820 KB saved. Creeks under five miles and creeks' timber are left off (ceiling).

liveBrowserProof.note: Same computer only. MAP=colonies PORT=8754 SEED=deal-proof PLAYERS=15. Households: hh-1 gonzales, hh-2 matagorda, hh-3 liberty and others. A student joined as hh-1 in the browser; hh-2 and hh-3 joined over HTTP, and the browser took over hh-3 with its family key through /api/rejoin.
observed: hh-1: settlementId gonzales; founding 'Dawn on September 28, 1835. Your family has turned off the road near Gonzales with the wagon, the ox and the horse, towards land of its own.'; Go to list 'Family 11 home · 8.7 miles', 'Family 4 home · 27.8 miles', 'Family 14 home · 37.4 miles'.

hh-3: settlementId liberty; founding '... turned off the road near Liberty ...'; land 9.0 miles from Liberty; Go to list 'Family 8 home · 5.1 miles' (the other Liberty family), then 66.0, 68.1, 68.9 miles; errands 'Take the cotton to the store', 'Buy powder and lead in town', 'Fetch seed from town', 'Sell food at the store for coin', 'Buy a hoe in town'.
Map round Liberty (canvas enlarged off-screen and cropped into the 280 x 235 pane): the Trinity meandering past, the homestead and its field, roads either side.
